title: Picking Robot Floor Plan
brief: Our warehouse floor is laid out as a grid of bays, and some bays are taken up by shelving. A picking robot starts in the top-left bay and has to reach the loading dock in the bottom-right bay, and it can only ever move one bay east or one bay south.

Implement countRobotRoutes(layout), where layout holds the floor plan row by row with 1 for a bay blocked by shelving and 0 for an open bay, and return how many different routes take the robot from the top-left bay to the bottom-right bay without entering a blocked bay.
